findings.title: Place Valhallarama contact for fallback defenders
findings.why_it_matters: A legal Valhallarama capture of Common or Garden uses the generic fallback defender, and the sword passes above the ellipse while the impact star also floats outside it. findings.title: Make both Librarian blades reach the defender
findings.why_it_matters: In the supplied portrait contact frames, the lower sword reaches the Hooligan shield, but the upper sword ends visibly above the opponent throughout the held impact. This fails the approved crossed two-blade contact beat even though both blades are foreground. A revised action pose or defender-relative positioning should bring both blades to the opponent.
findings.validation_reason: The legal Hooligan pawn capture in the consecutive Librarian contact frames shows one sword reaching the shield while the other ends above the defender throughout the held contact; the approved proposal specifies readable two-blade contact.
